name: terminal_send
description: INTERACTIVE only. Sends a line to a verified ALREADY-FOREGROUND terminal. Requires allow_desktop_interference=true. Refuses focus stealing; prefer run_command for CLI tasks.

name: window_controls
description: Read UI Automation controls inside ONE verified Windows window without moving the mouse or stealing focus. Choose a unique automation_id/name for window_action. Browser support varies.

device.description: Exact device ID returned by list_devices (only your own devices).

name: window_action
description: BACKGROUND ONLY. Invoke a uniquely identified button or set_value/toggle/select/expand/collapse via native Windows UI Automation. Verifies HWND, PID, title, exactly one control. Never injects mouse or keyboard. Unsupported UIA patterns fail closed; NO automatic desktop fallback.

device.description: Exact device ID returned by list_devices (only your own devices).

name: gui_desktop_create
description: Create an isolated Win32 Desktop for GUI applications inside the CURRENT Windows session. No VM. No cursor/focus change; limited to 3 per agent. Security isolation NOT guaranteed.

device.description: Exact device ID returned by list_devices (only your own devices).
